note: Pass 4b. Repeats of the unmodified pipeline with the repo default query, to measure run-to-run stability and to separate what the LLM review takes from names from what it takes from data. Four arms use the same sachs numbers (byte-identical bodies): sachs = real names + 'sachs' in the path; d01 = real names, neutral path; d02 = neutral names V01..V11; d03 = real names moved onto other proteins' columns. Two bundled synthetic datasets with ground truth are repeated as the no-domain-knowledge control. Interleaved so that time is not confounded with arm. 28 runs.
